findings.title: Administrative import bypasses the catalog write service

evidence.observation: Writes repository records directly instead of using the canonical service.

expected: All catalog writers enforce the same invariants.
impact: Imported records can bypass catalog invariants.

recommendation.action: Route imports through the canonical write service and cover the path with an integration test.
acceptance: CI rejects an invalid imported record
All catalog writers use the canonical boundary.

next_highest_leverage_improvement.action: Consolidate catalog writes behind one invariant-enforcing boundary and verify the import path in CI.
acceptance: One invalid-import integration test passes in CI
All writers use the service boundary
